title: Claude Code Deny Rules: Hide Your Secrets From AI
description:
Your AI agent can read your secrets unless you say no. 🔐

✅ Open .claude/settings.json
✅ Deny Read(./secrets/**) to hide a whole folder
✅ Deny Read(./.env.*) to hide every .env variant

Day 2 of Safe AI Agents! Next up, Day 3: Block Dangerous Commands with a Hook.
Follow for a new short every day and learn to lock down your AI coding agents.

#shorts #claudecode #aicoding #aiagents #aisecurity #cybersecurity #devsecops #programming

comment: Secrets folder or .env files: which would you hide first? Tell me in a word! Extra tip: Read deny rules are for file reads, so keep real keys out of the project folder when you can.
